clue.text: Railway employee working on and off

definitions.text: Railway employee working on and off

parts.words: Railway employee working on and off
parts.note: a rail worker whose job is to set points one way and then the other, flicking track from one line to another

explanation.surface: A railwayman who only turns up for work intermittently.
explanation.walkthrough: 'On and off' reads as 'intermittently', but it describes the job itself: changing points or signals from one setting to the other.
explanation.definitionFit: This rail worker operates the points that move trains between tracks.

clue.text: Nothing removed from hall in Cambridgeshire except nun's veil

indicators.note: removed from says the zero letter is taken out of the hall's name

parts.note: Wimpole Hall is a stately home in Cambridgeshire
nothing is zero, the letter O

explanation.surface: Everything at a Cambridgeshire stately home has been cleared out except a nun's headdress.
explanation.walkthrough: WIMPOLE Hall is a National Trust house in Cambridgeshire, England; 'except' is only a link.
explanation.definitionFit: This cloth headdress framing the face is worn by many nuns.

clue.text: Natural ability in story-book

parts.note: NT, the New Testament, is a book of the Bible

explanation.surface: A child's gift shows up in a book of stories.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonyms: an innate gift or aptitude for something.

clue.text: Nag, say, after nagging too much might be?

definitions.text: after nagging too much might be

indicators.note: say signals that the word for an old nag is spoken, giving a word of the same sound

parts.note: a nag is an old horse

explanation.surface: Someone who has nagged excessively might end up with a croaky voice.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Nag' looks like a verb matching 'nagging', but it is the noun, an old horse.
explanation.definitionFit: Shouting or nagging at length leaves the voice rough and croaky.

clue.text: Sad orators flow south, dazed and confused

indicators.note: dazed suggests things knocked out of order, so the preceding words are rearranged

parts.note: S is the compass abbreviation for south

explanation.surface: Gloomy speechmakers drift southward in a bewildered state.
explanation.walkthrough: 'dazed' rearranges SAD ORATORS FLOW into ATALOSSFORWORD; S for south finishes it.
explanation.definitionFit: Being stuck for what to say is an idiom for being bewildered or nonplussed.

clue.text: Formal and proper item I have that's rudimentary

parts.note: prim means stiffly formal and proper
it can stand for a thing or item, as in 'it is on the table'

explanation.surface: A stiff and correct possession of mine turns out to be basic.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonyms: crude, basic, at an early stage of development.

clue.text: At home in Paris

parts.note: a French phrase for being at home with one's family, read as 'at home' said the way Parisians would

explanation.surface: Relaxing at one's residence in the French capital.
explanation.definitionFit: The French expression means at home, among the family, informally.

clue.text: Spirited producer?

parts.note: a lively producer on the surface, but read as one who produces spirits such as whisky or gin

explanation.surface: A lively film or theatre producer.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who makes spirits like whisky by evaporating and condensing.

clue.text: Be including race, I concluded, in the country

indicators.note: concluded places the letter I at the end of the word
including says the race goes inside the two letters of be

explanation.surface: Instructions on including a race and finishing up somewhere in the nation.
explanation.definitionFit: A small sultanate on the island of Borneo in Southeast Asia.

clue.text: Wavering, a maltster became suspicious

indicators.note: wavering suggests unsteadiness, so the letters of the following words are rearranged

explanation.surface: A hesitant brewery malt worker started to have doubts.
explanation.definitionFit: An idiom meaning to sense that something is wrong or a trick is afoot.

clue.text: Skimp acting part to make an impression

indicators.note: part says only a portion of the words skimp acting is used, running across the gap

explanation.surface: An actor who skimps on their role still manages to leave a mark.
explanation.definitionFit: As a verb it means to affect strongly or leave a mark on something.

clue.text: Thin gloss removed from elastic propeller

indicators.note: removed here means shifted out of place, so the letters of the two words are rearranged

explanation.surface: A thin coat of shine has been stripped from a stretchy device.
explanation.definitionFit: A forked stick with a rubber band that launches stones, so a stretchy launcher.

clue.text: A test of the cavities of the heart

definitions.text: of the cavities of the heart

explanation.surface: A medical examination of the heart's chambers.
explanation.definitionFit: This adjective relates to the atria, the upper chambers of the heart.

clue.text: Rich one leaping

parts.note: a means one, as in 'a dozen'

explanation.surface: A wealthy person jumping for joy.
explanation.definitionFit: Rich in the sense of plentiful or teeming, as land rich in wildlife.

clue.text: Olfactory property of piece of worn cloth found in the country

indicators.note: found in says the scrap of cloth sits inside the country's name

parts.note: a rag is a scrap of worn-out cloth

explanation.surface: A tattered piece of fabric turned up abroad, noted for its smell.
explanation.definitionFit: A pleasant smell or scent is a property detected by the nose.

clue.text: Bring back control, say

parts.note: to rein is to control, as with a horse

explanation.surface: Restore control and make an announcement.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to restore someone to a former position.

clue.text: Greek character Penny is coming back

parts.note: P is the abbreviation for penny in British money

indicators.note: coming back says the word is is read backwards

explanation.surface: A woman named Penny is returning.
explanation.definitionFit: The twenty-third letter of the Greek alphabet.

clue.text: Drug container

definitions.meaning: a vessel such as a cooking or plant vessel

explanation.definitionFit: Both senses: slang for cannabis, and a round vessel for cooking or plants.

clue.text: One sergeant-major had distinctive theory

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A senior soldier with his own pet theory.
explanation.definitionFit: A suffix made a noun for any distinctive doctrine or belief system.

clue.text: Operatic stylist in Iberia

parts.note: a hairdresser from a Spanish city, title character of Rossini's comic opera

explanation.surface: A hairdresser in Spain with a flair for drama.
explanation.definitionFit: Rossini's opera is named after Figaro, a hairdresser in a southern Spanish city.

clue.text: Bell the cat

definitions.meaning: Great ... is a famous large bell, at Christ Church Oxford

explanation.definitionFit: Both senses: the name of famous large bells, and a male cat.

clue.text: Get run over, it becomes high-priority

indicators.note: over suggests being knocked down and rolled, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Being hit by a vehicle makes something an emergency.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: pressing, needing immediate attention.

clue.text: Coming from Penang in acute pain

indicators.note: Coming from says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Someone in Penang suffers sharp discomfort.
explanation.definitionFit: A medical term for chest pain caused by poor blood flow to the heart.

clue.text: Happen to exist and become a victim

parts.note: to fall is to become a casualty, as soldiers fall in battle

explanation.surface: To live and then fall prey to something.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: something befalls a person when it happens to them.

clue.text: A French drama — heard but not viewed

indicators.note: heard signals that the word for a piece of drama is spoken, giving a same-sounding word

parts.note: a scene is a dramatic episode or section of a play

explanation.surface: A French play that was listened to on the radio but never watched.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: not seen, unobserved.

clue.text: Drastic going from side to side, point accepted

indicators.note: accepted says the compass letter is taken inside the word for moving to and fro

parts.note: swinging means moving to and fro
E is a compass point, east

explanation.surface: A pendulum's motion with a sharp point taken on board is severe.
explanation.walkthrough: SWINGEING, a mainly British word, is used for severe cuts or charges.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: severe, very large in amount, as with heavy cuts.

clue.text: Go missing, goatherd suffered famine

indicators.note: suffered suggests damage, so the remaining letters are rearranged
missing says the two letters of go are absent from the herdsman

explanation.surface: A goat herder who went astray endured starvation.
explanation.walkthrough: 'missing' removes GO from GOATHERD to leave ATHERD; 'suffered' rearranges it.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a scarcity or lack, especially of food.

clue.text: Cross Rita tried moving

indicators.note: moving says the letters are shifted about into a new order

explanation.surface: Rita was angry because she had attempted to relocate.
explanation.definitionFit: A plain synonym: someone cross is annoyed or put out, as when provoked by another's behaviour.

clue.text: Subtle point, tiny adjustment accommodating this in Lyon

indicators.note: accommodating says the rearranged letters hold the French word inside
adjustment says the letters are rearranged

parts.note: ce is French for this, Lyon being a French city

explanation.surface: A fine distinction made through a small tweak in a French city.
explanation.walkthrough: 'adjustment' turns TINY into NITY, which holds CE.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a fine detail or delicate distinction.

clue.text: Like what seamen are doing beginning hostilities

explanation.surface: How sailors behave when war breaks out.
explanation.definitionFit: Assailing means attacking, so launching an assault or opening hostilities.
